stem: Which statement correctly describes a mixture?
options: Its components combine chemically in a fixed ratio.
Each component keeps its properties and does not react.
It is made of only one kind of particle throughout.
It cannot be split into its parts by any physical process.
explanation: Correct option: (B). A mixture is formed when two or more substances are mixed so that each keeps its own properties; its components do not react chemically. Combining in a fixed ratio describes a compound, having one kind of particle describes a pure substance, and a mixture can be separated by physical methods.

stem: A student says that stainless steel is a pure substance because it looks the same throughout. Which response is the most accurate?
options: It is a uniform mixture of iron, nickel, chromium and carbon.
It is a pure element because iron is by far its main component.
It is a compound because its metals are evenly spread.

A compound keeps all the properties of its elements.

stem: While heating dry sugar, small water droplets appear near the open end of the boiling tube. Which conclusion is correct?
options: The droplets came from the air, so sugar has no hydrogen.
Sugar contains hydrogen and oxygen, so it is not an element.
Sugar simply melted into water, so this is a physical change.
